title: Threat-intel names of batch p1-G07-1 (otx, otx_keyless, abusech, ioc_feeds_offline, ioc_feeds_unreviewed)

attributes.otx_pulse_count: number of AlienVault OTX pulses listing the indicator (provider total; pulse membership alone is not a verdict)
attributes.otx_pulses: newest OTX pulses listing the indicator: list of {name, author, date, link} (top 3)
attributes.allowlisted: list of allow-list reasons a source gives for the entity (whitelist, known false positive, warninglist)
attributes.upstream_families: upstream intelligence families behind a source's answer (P171: consensus counts families, never modules)
attributes.threat_actors: threat actor / adversary names a source associates with the entity (community labels unless stated otherwise)
attributes.attack_techniques: MITRE ATT&CK technique ids a source associates with the entity
attributes.passive_dns: passive DNS observations: list of {hostname, address, record_type, first_seen, last_seen}
attributes.observed_urls: URLs a source observed on the domain, IP or URL: list of {url, date, http_code}
attributes.malware_samples: malware sample hashes a source associates with the entity: list of {hash, type, date}
attributes.cwe: CWE weakness id(s) of a CVE
attributes.exploited_in_wild: bool: a source reports in-the-wild exploitation of the CVE
attributes.url_status: URLhaus status of the listed URL(s): online | offline | unknown
attributes.threat_type: threat type assigned by the source (e.g. botnet_cc, payload_delivery, malware_download)
attributes.source_confidence: confidence level the source assigns to its listing (0-100, e.g. ThreatFox confidence_level)
attributes.similarity_hashes: similarity/structural hashes of a file: {imphash, tlsh, ssdeep, telfhash, gimphash, dhash_icon}
attributes.yara_rules: YARA rule names a source reports as matching the file
attributes.av_signatures: antivirus signature names a source reports for the file (e.g. ClamAV)
attributes.delivery_method: how a malware sample was delivered according to the source (e.g. email_attachment, web_download)
attributes.url_count: number of URLs a source lists for the host or payload
attributes.ioc_count: number of indicators a source lists for the entity (e.g. the IOCs of a malware family), per source
attributes.feed_hits: offline feed listings of the entity: list of {feed, family, actor, label, first_seen, last_seen, confidence, age_days, reference}
attributes.feed_status: state of each offline feed consulted: {feed: {state ok | stale | unhealthy | missing, age_hours, fetched_at}}

tags.historical: listing or observation older than 30 days, removed or from a frozen list: not current state
tags.abused_legit_service: legitimate service (file hosting, CDN) abused to host malicious content: never malicious by itself

relations.hosts_url: domain/IP -> URL observed or listed on it (OTX URL list, URLhaus host listings)
relations.serves_payload: URL/host -> hash of a payload it served (URLhaus)
relations.served_from: file hash -> URL that distributed it (URLhaus payload listings)
relations.contacted_by: C2 IP/domain/URL -> malware sample hash that contacts or contacted it
relations.same_file: file hash -> another hash (md5/sha1/sha256) of the same file
relations.similarity_hash: file hash -> similarity/structural hash of the file (imphash, tlsh, ssdeep, telfhash, gimphash, icon dhash)
